name: Business Plan and Appraisal
description: The course would broadly cover the entrepreneurial environment, organizing and operating the venture, planning for the future and creating and recognizing venture value. It would also equip students with the necessary tools and skills to make business pitches, develop business plans and also evaluate business ideas. The course would require students to make business pitches and there would be student teams evaluating them critically, at the same time.
